oil.semantic: Generated dark-on-white coverage drives weak reflection film. Local coverage-contrast separation retains original irregular ridge contacts; image brightness is never height.
oil.fingerprintFootprintMM: Authored 14–16 mm width × 18–20 mm length. Source ridge contacts retain generated local spacing, not a measured human print.
oil.repeatPolicy: Macro millimeter chart independent of the fine machining tile; renderer supplies integer barrel repeats/part phase.

pitAuthoring: Independent seeded micron-scale pits; 80% associated with numerical deposit coverage, 20% bare contact. Image brightness is never height.
abrasionAuthoring: Independent sparse physical Gaussian cuts, width sigma .08–.14 mm, depth .5–2.5 microns; sub-texel grooves are represented by the preserved fine machining maps, not aliased here.
colorAuthoring: ImageGen oxide color only for steel; independent neutral aluminum and brown/green bronze deposit palettes. Broad oil affects reflection with <=.035 color coverage.
coordinateConvention: Float arrays +V up; raster rows flipped once; flat clean perimeter.

colorCoverage.RGB: sRGB target color, pale/neutral metal film or localized contaminant
colorCoverage.A: linear color coverage; <=.035 pure oil, paired with G for deposit cores

surface.G: opaque deposit coverage; dielectric core response
surface.B: thin oil/fingerprint roughness coverage; retains substrate metalness

channels.normal: OpenGL +Y tangent normal from independent abrasion and pit height; linear

macroMapping: Physical-mm macro chart independent of fine grain; renderer supplies integer barrel repeats, fixed phase and deposit edge protection.
